chunks: He has a high position with Us and an excellent abode.

key_terms.حُسْنَ مَآبٍ: A beautiful abode or return (in the Hereafter)
key_terms.لَزُلْفَىٰ: Closeness or high favor with God

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Zulfa' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited as evidence for the unique spiritual proximity (zulfa) of the Ahl al-Bayt to God, with many scholars interpreting the 'beautiful return' as the ultimate reward of Imamate and intercession. It underscores the divine favor bestowed upon the Prophet and his progeny, distinguishing their status through both nearness to the Divine and an excellent final destination in the Hereafter.
